name: OG STREAM STUDIO
description: OG STREAM STUDIO ek halka Android streaming app hai, jo low-end phone par game screen, mic aur game sound ko seedha YouTube live par bhejta hai. Isme movable canvas layers, text/image/web overlay, volume aur mute controls, floating LIVE bubble, aur "STREAMING SOON" wala BRB mode hai.
